age.evidence: A total of 42 C57BL6/J mice (both sexes) at postnatal (P) day 60 (P60)

sex.evidence: A total of 42 C57BL6/J mice (both sexes)

dosing.evidence: ibogaine-HCl was dissolved at 4 mg/ml in EtOH 10%, and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 40 mg/kg. Control animals were administered with vehicle (VEH; EtOH 10%).

handling.evidence: All animals were habituated prior to testing through gentle handling and by being placed on the arena platform for 30 s to 1 min before stimulus presentation began.

group_housing.evidence: housed (6 per cage) in ventilated cages with positive pressure

day_night_flipped.evidence: 14/10 h light-dark cycle (direction/timing of lights not specified)

assays.assay_description: Unrestrained mouse placed on a circular platform (5 cm diameter, 13 cm high) in a 35 cm square arena of four monitors with mirrors on roof and floor; vertical sine-wave gratings (0.1–0.8 c/d) drifted clockwise then counterclockwise (30 s each, 12°/s, 100% contrast). Head movements matching grating direction/speed were scored from video; visual acuity = highest spatial frequency eliciting a response, measured for each eye. Run in non-deprived vehicle/ibogaine mice and in vehicle/ibogaine mice after 4 days of monocular deprivation (collapsed into one assay).

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 40 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: All animals were habituated prior to testing through gentle handling and by being placed on the arena platform for 30 s to 1 min before stimulus presentation began.

setup_restrain.evidence: A circular platform ... was secured on the center of the bottom mirror, where the mouse was placed unrestrained.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the OMR arena (platform within monitor/mirror arena); home-cage diet ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the OMR arena; home-cage water freely available.

time_to_assay.evidence: Adult (P60) mice were treated with vehicle or ibogaine (40 mg/Kg) and 6 days later visual acuity was measured; MD cohort: MD 24 h after ibogaine, kept for four days, eyelids reopened the day before the optomotor test (~6 days post-dose).

sample_size.evidence: VEH ... n=6; IBO ... n=6 (Fig. 1); VEH MD ... n=10; IBO MD ... n=8 (Fig. 2)

outcomes.summary: Ibogaine (40 mg/kg) alone did not change visual acuity of either eye. After 4 days of monocular deprivation, ibogaine-treated adult mice showed reduced visual acuity in the deprived eye relative to the non-deprived eye, whereas vehicle-treated mice showed no interocular difference, indicating restored juvenile-like plasticity.
outcomes.evidence: in ibogaine-treated mice, visual acuity of the right (R) deprived eye was reduced in comparison to the left (L) un-deprived eye (IBO L: 0.393±0.016 (c/d) vs. IBO R: 0.256±0.022 (c/d), n=8, t26=7.221, p< 0.001). On the contrary, visual acuity of R deprived and L un-deprived eye was similar in vehicle-treated mice

B1_num_measures.evidence: Visual acuity was determined as the highest spatial frequency of the stimulus at which the mouse gave a response.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: No within-session temporal analysis; frequencies presented in random order to avoid confounding effects of time or fatigue.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Videos were analyzed by quantifying head movements and comparing them to the direction of the stimulus (reflexive optomotor tracking).

B5_social.evidence: Mouse tested alone on the platform; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Optomotor response is an innate reflex; no learning or memory required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Videos were analyzed by quantifying head movements; no automated behavioural classifier reported.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only linear mixed model on visual acuity (univariate).

E1_environment_type.evidence: Mice were put in an arena that consisted of four monitors arranged in a quadrangle (square, 35 cm side length), and two mirrors

E2_shelter.evidence: Mouse on an open circular platform; no shelter described.

E3_bedding.evidence: A circular platform ... was secured on the center of the bottom mirror; no bedding.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single circular platform at the centre of the arena; no compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: where the mouse was placed unrestrained (single animal on platform)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the OMR arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each cohort tested once on the optomotor test (6 days after treatment or after MD reopening).

D2_session_duration.evidence: Total session duration not explicitly stated (each trial 30 s clockwise + 30 s counterclockwise).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each animal tested on one day; number of testing days not explicitly reported.

D5_followup.evidence: Adult (P60) mice were treated with vehicle or ibogaine (40 mg/Kg) and 6 days later visual acuity was measured

judge_notes: Single behavioural assay (OMR); Golgi spine density, WFA/PV and vGAT immunostaining are histological and excluded. Non-deprived and MD cohorts collapsed into one OMR assay.
B1 set to score 0: one measure (visual acuity) maps to 0 points; gemma4's score of 1 was a scoring error.
n_total = 6+6+10+8 = 30 (qwen/deepseek4); gemma4's 34 does not match figure n's.

D2 kept at 0 but low confidence because total session length is not explicitly stated; D3 = 1 (modal), low confidence since per-animal testing days not reported; deepseek4's 2-7 counted cohorts rather than recording days per assay.
D5 = Yes (modal qwen/deepseek4): testing ~6 days post-dose. time_to_assay set to short_term_1to7d (both cohorts ~6 days post-injection) rather than gemma4's 'multiple'.
sex_dependent set to not_reported: both sexes used but sex not analysed as a factor, so n/a (one sex only) does not apply.
Handling = yes (modal) based on 'habituated prior to testing through gentle handling', though no detailed protocol given (medium confidence).
